package.name: gem_pp_visualization
package.description: Shared RViz visualization for pure pursuit: full recorded track, the path actually driven so far, the current pursuit target waypoint, and the lat/lon origin used for the local frame. Works with both gem_gnss_control (GNSS-direct) and gem_odometry_control (fused wheel+IMU+GPS) pure pursuit variants - it only needs a nav_msgs/Odometry pose topic and a geometry_msgs/PointStamped target topic, both of which are common conventions the two packages publish.
